      summary: Adds a pet owner

        was already used to create an owner, the originally created owner is returned with 200
        instead of creating a duplicate.
      parameters:
        - name: Idempotency-Key
          in: header
          description: Client-supplied key that makes repeated creates return the original owner.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            maxLength: 255

        description: The pet owner

            schema:

        200:

          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:

        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        409:
          description: >-
            Conflict: an owner with the same 'identityKey' (telephone, email and household ID)
            already exists, an owner of the same household (last name and postcode) already exists
            and 'sharesHousehold' is not set, or the owner's city already contains 50 or more owners.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        429:
          description: Too many requests; 100 or more owners have already been created today.

              schema:

        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The flat postal address of the pet owner, still accepted for backward compatibility.
            On create, either 'address' or a non-blank 'addressLine1' must be supplied; when
            'addressLine1' is present the structured fields take precedence. Addresses are
            normalized (trimmed, whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, ST/RD/AVE expanded). In
            responses this is the composed normalized address: 'addressLine1', followed by a
            single space and 'addressLine2' when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. LIBERTY STREET'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured address. Preferred over 'address' when
            present and non-blank; normalized like 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured address; normalized like 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner, stored and returned in E.164 form. Spaces,
            dashes and brackets are removed. A leading '+' and country code are kept; otherwise
            a single leading '0' is dropped and country code '+61' is assumed. Between 8 and 15
            digits must follow the '+', e.g. '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'. Numbers
            with country code '+61' must have exactly 9 national digits and numbers with country
            code '+1' exactly 10.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a syntactically
            valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased. An address at a disposable
            email domain (mailinator.com, tempmail.com, guerrillamail.com, or a subdomain of one)
            is rejected with 400 Bad Request.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be valid for the
            region of the owner's city per the fixed table NSW (Sydney) 2000-2099, VIC (Melbourne)
            3000-3099, QLD (Brisbane) 4000-4099; a postcode outside its city's range is rejected
            with 400 Bad Request. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner registered with the clinic. On create, when omitted it defaults to
            the server's current date. A Saturday, Sunday or public holiday (2026-01-01,
            2026-01-26, 2026-04-25, 2026-12-25, 2026-12-28), whether supplied or defaulted, is
            rolled forward to the next business day that is neither a weekend nor a holiday. A supplied date later than the server's current date
            is rejected with 400 Bad Request.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, used to derive 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific of the pet owner, used to compose 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: 'DR'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Set to true on create to declare that the new owner shares the household of existing
            owners with the same last name and postcode (see 'householdId'). Without it, creating an
            owner whose household already has members is rejected with 409 Conflict; with it, the
            owner is created as a household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. It
            does not affect the 'householdId' itself. Not stored.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the stored names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The relative URI of this owner resource, '/api/owners/' followed by the owner ID.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                Assigned on create as '<REGION>-<HASH8>': the region whose postcode range contains
                the postcode (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099; when the postcode is absent
                or in no range, the region of the city as for 'locality', otherwise 'UNKNOWN'), a dash,
                and the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes of the
                normalized telephone followed by the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-3FA9C27B'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in 'customerCode',
                ignoring all non-digit characters. Absent when the owner has no customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 6
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Deterministic identifier shared by owners in the same household: the first 12
                lower-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of '<lastName>|<postcode>', with the last
                name trimmed, whitespace-collapsed and lower-cased. Owners with the same last name and
                postcode therefore always share it. Absent for owners without a postcode.
              type: string
              example: '3f2b8c1e7a4d'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                Derived identity used for duplicate detection, formatted as
                '<telephone>|<email>|<householdId>' from the normalized telephone, the lower-cased
                email (empty when absent) and the household ID (empty when absent). Creating an owner
                whose whole identity key equals an existing owner's is rejected with 409 Conflict;
                owners differing in any part, e.g. household members with different telephones, are
                allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                Assigned on create: the number of owners that already existed before this owner was
                created with the same first name and last name, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 0
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                Formatted as '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal
                year (see 'fiscalYear') containing the registration date, e.g. 'NSW-3FA9C27B-M27'
                for a registration date of 2026-10-14. Absent when the owner has no customer code or
                registration date.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-3FA9C27B-M20'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year containing the (business-day adjusted) registration date, formatted
                as 'FY<YY>'. A fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named after the calendar year in
                which it ends, so 2026-07-01 through 2027-06-30 is 'FY27'. Absent when the owner has
                no registration date.
              type: string
              pattern: '^FY[0-9]{2}$'
              example: 'FY20'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                Assigned on create: starts at 0, plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when
                'namesakeCount' is 0, plus 2 when the owner's household has 3 or more members
                (including the owner), plus 3 for a tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal year
                (counted as the number of fiscal-year starts on 1 July passed since the registration
                date, not in 365-day windows). A newly created owner has zero tenure, so it never
                earns the tenure points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                Derived from 'membershipPoints': 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5
                points, 4 for 6 or more points. Capped on create at one above the highest
                'membershipLevel' among the owner's existing (non-deleted) household members; no cap
                applies when the household has no other members.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The REGION part of 'customerCode'. For owners without a customer code, the region
                whose postcode range contains the postcode, otherwise the region derived from the city
                using the fixed table Sydney -> 'NSW', Melbourne -> 'VIC', Brisbane -> 'QLD';
                'UNKNOWN' for any other city.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's title followed by a space and the last name, e.g. 'DR Franklin'; just
                the last name when the owner has no title.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                'EMAIL' when the owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Assigned on create: true when more than 80 owners had already been created for the
                same (business-day adjusted) registration date before this owner, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Assigned on create: true when the owner is not a duplicate by identity key but an
                existing owner has the same 'householdId' with a different telephone; the owner is
                still created. Always false for declared household members ('sharesHousehold'), and
                since an undeclared owner of an existing household is rejected, false in practice.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The ID of the earliest-created existing owner that made this owner a possible duplicate.
                Absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                Derived from 'birthDate' as the owner's age in completed years on the registration
                date: 'MINOR' under 18, 'ADULT' 18-64, 'SENIOR' 65 or over. Absent when the owner has
                no birth date or registration date.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: '+', the country code, a space and
                the national digits grouped in threes separated by spaces, with a trailing single
                digit joined to the preceding group, e.g. '+61 412 345 678' or '+1 608 555 2654'.
                'telephone' itself stays in raw E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from 'locality' using the fixed table
                'NSW' -> 'Australia/Sydney', 'VIC' -> 'Australia/Melbourne',
                'QLD' -> 'Australia/Brisbane'. Absent for any other locality.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                True once the owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE /api/owners/{ownerId}; false
                for a newly created owner. Deleted owners are retained and still returned, but are
                ignored by the duplicate household and identity key checks on create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page

openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: >-
        Records the details of a new pet owner. When the request repeats an 'Idempotency-Key' that
        was already used to create an owner, the originally created owner is returned with 200
        instead of creating a duplicate.
      parameters:
        - name: Idempotency-Key
          in: header
          description: Client-supplied key that makes repeated creates return the original owner.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            maxLength: 255
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        200:
          description: >-
            The 'Idempotency-Key' was already used; the originally created pet owner is returned.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        409:
          description: >-
            Conflict: a non-deleted owner with the same 'identityKey' (telephone, email and soundex
            of the last name) already exists, or the owner's city already contains 50 or more owners.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        429:
          description: Too many requests; 100 or more owners have already been created today.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:
      tags:
        - owner-v2
      operationId: listOwnersPage
      summary: Lists pet owners with pagination
      description: Returns a page of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The flat postal address of the pet owner, still accepted for backward compatibility.
            On create, either 'address' or a non-blank 'addressLine1' must be supplied; when
            'addressLine1' is present the structured fields take precedence. Addresses are
            normalized (trimmed, whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, ST/RD/AVE expanded). In
            responses this is the composed normalized address: 'addressLine1', followed by a
            single space and 'addressLine2' when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. LIBERTY STREET'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured address. Preferred over 'address' when
            present and non-blank; normalized like 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured address; normalized like 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner, stored and returned in E.164 form. Spaces,
            dashes and brackets are removed. A leading '+' and country code are kept; otherwise
            a single leading '0' is dropped and country code '+61' is assumed. Between 8 and 15
            digits must follow the '+', e.g. '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'. Numbers
            with country code '+61' must have exactly 9 national digits and numbers with country
            code '+1' exactly 10.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a syntactically
            valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased. An address at a disposable
            email domain (mailinator.com, tempmail.com, guerrillamail.com, or a subdomain of one)
            is rejected with 400 Bad Request.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be valid for the
            region of the owner's city per the fixed table NSW (Sydney) 2000-2099, VIC (Melbourne)
            3000-3099, QLD (Brisbane) 4000-4099; a postcode outside its city's range is rejected
            with 400 Bad Request. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner registered with the clinic. On create, when omitted it defaults to
            the server's current date. A Saturday, Sunday or public holiday (2026-01-01,
            2026-01-26, 2026-04-25, 2026-12-25, 2026-12-28), whether supplied or defaulted, is
            rolled forward to the next business day that is neither a weekend nor a holiday. A supplied date later than the server's current date
            is rejected with 400 Bad Request.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, used to derive 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific of the pet owner, used to compose 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: 'DR'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Set to true on create to declare that the new owner shares the household of existing
            owners with the same last name and postcode (see 'householdId'). Without it, creating an
            owner whose household already has members is rejected with 409 Conflict; with it, the
            owner is created as a household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. It
            does not affect the 'householdId' itself. Not stored.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the stored names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The relative URI of this owner resource, '/api/owners/' followed by the owner ID.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                Assigned on create as '<REGION>-<HASH8>': the region whose postcode range contains
                the postcode (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099; when the postcode is absent
                or in no range, the region of the city as for 'locality', otherwise 'UNKNOWN'), a dash,
                and the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes of the
                normalized telephone followed by the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-3FA9C27B'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in 'customerCode',
                ignoring all non-digit characters. Absent when the owner has no customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 6
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Deterministic identifier shared by owners in the same household: the first 12
                lower-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of '<lastName>|<postcode>', with the last
                name trimmed, whitespace-collapsed and lower-cased. Owners with the same last name and
                postcode therefore always share it. Absent for owners without a postcode.
              type: string
              example: '3f2b8c1e7a4d'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                Derived identity used for duplicate detection, formatted as
                '<telephone>|<email>|<householdId>' from the normalized telephone, the lower-cased
                email (empty when absent) and the household ID (empty when absent). Creating an owner
                whose whole identity key equals an existing owner's is rejected with 409 Conflict;
                owners differing in any part, e.g. household members with different telephones, are
                allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                Assigned on create: the number of owners that already existed before this owner was
                created with the same first name and last name, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 0
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                Formatted as '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal
                year (see 'fiscalYear') containing the registration date, e.g. 'NSW-3FA9C27B-M27'
                for a registration date of 2026-10-14. Absent when the owner has no customer code or
                registration date.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-3FA9C27B-M20'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year containing the (business-day adjusted) registration date, formatted
                as 'FY<YY>'. A fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named after the calendar year in
                which it ends, so 2026-07-01 through 2027-06-30 is 'FY27'. Absent when the owner has
                no registration date.
              type: string
              pattern: '^FY[0-9]{2}$'
              example: 'FY20'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                Assigned on create: starts at 0, plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when
                'namesakeCount' is 0, plus 2 when the owner's household has 3 or more members
                (including the owner), plus 3 for a tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal year
                (counted as the number of fiscal-year starts on 1 July passed since the registration
                date, not in 365-day windows). A newly created owner has zero tenure, so it never
                earns the tenure points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                Derived from 'membershipPoints': 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5
                points, 4 for 6 or more points. Capped on create at one above the highest
                'membershipLevel' among the owner's existing (non-deleted) household members; no cap
                applies when the household has no other members.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The REGION part of 'customerCode'. For owners without a customer code, the region
                whose postcode range contains the postcode, otherwise the region derived from the city
                using the fixed table Sydney -> 'NSW', Melbourne -> 'VIC', Brisbane -> 'QLD';
                'UNKNOWN' for any other city.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's title followed by a space and the last name, e.g. 'DR Franklin'; just
                the last name when the owner has no title.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                'EMAIL' when the owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Assigned on create: true when more than 80 owners had already been created for the
                same (business-day adjusted) registration date before this owner, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Assigned on create: true when the owner is not a duplicate by identity key but an
                existing owner has the same 'householdId' with a different telephone; the owner is
                still created. Always false for declared household members ('sharesHousehold'), and
                since an undeclared owner of an existing household is rejected, false in practice.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The ID of the earliest-created existing owner that made this owner a possible duplicate.
                Absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                Derived from 'birthDate' as the owner's age in completed years on the registration
                date: 'MINOR' under 18, 'ADULT' 18-64, 'SENIOR' 65 or over. Absent when the owner has
                no birth date or registration date.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: '+', the country code, a space and
                the national digits grouped in threes separated by spaces, with a trailing single
                digit joined to the preceding group, e.g. '+61 412 345 678' or '+1 608 555 2654'.
                'telephone' itself stays in raw E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from 'locality' using the fixed table
                'NSW' -> 'Australia/Sydney', 'VIC' -> 'Australia/Melbourne',
                'QLD' -> 'Australia/Brisbane'. Absent for any other locality.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                True once the owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE /api/owners/{ownerId}; false
                for a newly created owner. Deleted owners are retained and still returned, but are
                ignored by the duplicate household and identity key checks on create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: >-
        Records the details of a new pet owner. When the request repeats an 'Idempotency-Key' that
        was already used to create an owner, the originally created owner is returned with 200
        instead of creating a duplicate.
      parameters:
        - name: Idempotency-Key
          in: header
          description: Client-supplied key that makes repeated creates return the original owner.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            maxLength: 255
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        200:
          description: >-
            The 'Idempotency-Key' was already used; the originally created pet owner is returned.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        409:
          description: >-
            Conflict: a non-deleted owner with the same 'identityKey' (telephone, email and soundex
            of the last name) already exists, or the owner's city already contains 50 or more owners.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        429:
          description: Too many requests; 100 or more owners have already been created today.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:
      tags:
        - owner-v2
      operationId: listOwnersPage
      summary: Lists pet owners with pagination
      description: Returns a page of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
            example: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          description: Number of items per page.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
            example: 5
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner page found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerPage'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            Etag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners/{ownerId}:
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: getOwner
      summary: Get a pet owner by ID
      description: Returns the pet owner or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    put:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: updateOwner
      summary: Update a pet owner's details
      description: Updates the pet owner record with the specified details.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner details to use for the update.
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        200:
          description: Update successful.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The flat postal address of the pet owner, still accepted for backward compatibility.
            On create, either 'address' or a non-blank 'addressLine1' must be supplied; when
            'addressLine1' is present the structured fields take precedence. Addresses are
            normalized (trimmed, whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, ST/RD/AVE expanded). In
            responses this is the composed normalized address: 'addressLine1', followed by a
            single space and 'addressLine2' when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. LIBERTY STREET'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured address. Preferred over 'address' when
            present and non-blank; normalized like 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured address; normalized like 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner, stored and returned in E.164 form. Spaces,
            dashes and brackets are removed. A leading '+' and country code are kept; otherwise
            a single leading '0' is dropped and country code '+61' is assumed. Between 8 and 15
            digits must follow the '+', e.g. '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'. Numbers
            with country code '+61' must have exactly 9 national digits and numbers with country
            code '+1' exactly 10.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a syntactically
            valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased. An address at a disposable
            email domain (mailinator.com, tempmail.com, guerrillamail.com, or a subdomain of one)
            is rejected with 400 Bad Request.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be valid for the
            region of the owner's city per the fixed table NSW (Sydney) 2000-2099, VIC (Melbourne)
            3000-3099, QLD (Brisbane) 4000-4099; a postcode outside its city's range is rejected
            with 400 Bad Request. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner registered with the clinic. On create, when omitted it defaults to
            the server's current date. A Saturday, Sunday or public holiday (2026-01-01,
            2026-01-26, 2026-04-25, 2026-12-25, 2026-12-28), whether supplied or defaulted, is
            rolled forward to the next business day that is neither a weekend nor a holiday. A supplied date later than the server's current date
            is rejected with 400 Bad Request.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, used to derive 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific of the pet owner, used to compose 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: 'DR'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Set to true on create to declare that the new owner shares the household of existing
            owners with the same last name and postcode (see 'householdId'). With it, the owner is
            not flagged as a possible duplicate. It does not affect the 'householdId' itself or
            duplicate detection by 'identityKey'. Not stored.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the stored names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The relative URI of this owner resource, '/api/owners/' followed by the owner ID.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                Assigned on create as '<REGION>-<HASH8>': the region whose postcode range contains
                the postcode (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099; when the postcode is absent
                or in no range, the region of the city as for 'locality', otherwise 'UNKNOWN'), a dash,
                and the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes of the
                normalized telephone followed by the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-3FA9C27B'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in 'customerCode',
                ignoring all non-digit characters. Absent when the owner has no customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 6
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Deterministic identifier shared by owners in the same household: the first 12
                lower-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of '<lastName>|<postcode>', with the last
                name trimmed, whitespace-collapsed and lower-cased. Owners with the same last name and
                postcode therefore always share it. Absent for owners without a postcode.
              type: string
              example: '3f2b8c1e7a4d'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                Derived identity used for duplicate detection, formatted as
                '<telephone>|<email>|<householdId>' from the normalized telephone, the lower-cased
                email (empty when absent) and the household ID (empty when absent). Creating an owner
                whose whole identity key equals an existing owner's is rejected with 409 Conflict;
                owners differing in any part, e.g. household members with different telephones, are
                allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                Assigned on create: the number of owners that already existed before this owner was
                created with the same first name and last name, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 0
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                Formatted as '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal
                year (see 'fiscalYear') containing the registration date, e.g. 'NSW-3FA9C27B-M27'
                for a registration date of 2026-10-14. Absent when the owner has no customer code or
                registration date.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-3FA9C27B-M20'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year containing the (business-day adjusted) registration date, formatted
                as 'FY<YY>'. A fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named after the calendar year in
                which it ends, so 2026-07-01 through 2027-06-30 is 'FY27'. Absent when the owner has
                no registration date.
              type: string
              pattern: '^FY[0-9]{2}$'
              example: 'FY20'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                Assigned on create: starts at 0, plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when
                'namesakeCount' is 0, plus 2 when the owner's household has 3 or more members
                (including the owner), plus 3 for a tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal year
                (counted as the number of fiscal-year starts on 1 July passed since the registration
                date, not in 365-day windows). A newly created owner has zero tenure, so it never
                earns the tenure points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                Derived from 'membershipPoints': 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5
                points, 4 for 6 or more points. Capped on create at one above the highest
                'membershipLevel' among the owner's existing (non-deleted) household members; no cap
                applies when the household has no other members.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The REGION part of 'customerCode'. For owners without a customer code, the region
                whose postcode range contains the postcode, otherwise the region derived from the city
                using the fixed table Sydney -> 'NSW', Melbourne -> 'VIC', Brisbane -> 'QLD';
                'UNKNOWN' for any other city.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's title followed by a space and the last name, e.g. 'DR Franklin'; just
                the last name when the owner has no title.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                'EMAIL' when the owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Assigned on create: true when more than 80 owners had already been created for the
                same (business-day adjusted) registration date before this owner, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Assigned on create: true when the owner is not a duplicate by identity key but an
                existing owner has the same 'householdId' with a different telephone; the owner is
                still created. Always false for declared household members ('sharesHousehold'), and
                since an undeclared owner of an existing household is rejected, false in practice.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The ID of the earliest-created existing owner that made this owner a possible duplicate.
                Absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                Derived from 'birthDate' as the owner's age in completed years on the registration
                date: 'MINOR' under 18, 'ADULT' 18-64, 'SENIOR' 65 or over. Absent when the owner has
                no birth date or registration date.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: '+', the country code, a space and
                the national digits grouped in threes separated by spaces, with a trailing single
                digit joined to the preceding group, e.g. '+61 412 345 678' or '+1 608 555 2654'.
                'telephone' itself stays in raw E.164 form.
              type: string

              readOnly: true

                'NSW' -> 'Australia/Sydney', 'VIC' -> 'Australia/Melbourne',
                'QLD' -> 'Australia/Brisbane'. Absent for any other locality.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true

paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: >-
        Records the details of a new pet owner. When the request repeats an 'Idempotency-Key' that
        was already used to create an owner, the originally created owner is returned with 200
        instead of creating a duplicate.
      parameters:
        - name: Idempotency-Key
          in: header
          description: Client-supplied key that makes repeated creates return the original owner.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            maxLength: 255
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        200:
          description: >-
            The 'Idempotency-Key' was already used; the originally created pet owner is returned.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        409:
          description: >-
            Conflict: a non-deleted owner with the same 'identityKey' (telephone, email and soundex
            of the last name) already exists, or the owner's city already contains 50 or more owners.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        429:
          description: Too many requests; 100 or more owners have already been created today.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
